name: Ai economy

subjectOf.text: Economic institutions that rely on lagging indicators such as price signals, employment data, and GDP reports cannot detect AI driven transformation, because the transformation propagates faster than the monitoring systems built to observe it.
subjectOf.abstract: Institutions in linear systems that depend on advance warning—price signals, employment data, and GDP reports—cannot detect a transformation that propagates faster than the information systems designed to monitor it.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319
scope_conditions: applies to institutions whose detection depends on advance warning indicators

subjectOf.text: Agentic Decoupling, defined as the progressive severance of value creation from human labor and consumption, is what distinguishes the AI transition from all prior technological transitions.
subjectOf.abstract: What distinguishes this moment from all prior technological transitions is what I have termed Agentic Decoupling: the progressive severance of value creation from human labor and consumption.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319
